chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, from Ahmad ibn al-Qasim al-'Ijli, from Ahmad ibn Yahya known as Kurd, from Muhammad ibn Khudahiyy, from Abdullah ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Hashim, from Abd al-Karim ibn Amr al-Khath'ami, from Hababa al-Walibiyya who said:

I saw the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) among the elite guard (shurtat al-khamis), and with him was a whip with two tips. He was striking with it the sellers of eel, moray, and catfish (forbidden fish), and saying to them: 'O sellers of the metamorphosed ones of the Children of Israel and the army of the clan of Marwan!' Then Furat ibn Akhnaf stood up toward him and said: 'O Commander of the Faithful, and what is the army of the clan of Marwan?' He said: So he said to him: 'Peoples who shaved their beards and twisted their moustaches, so they were transformed.'

I had never seen a speaker more eloquent than him. Then I followed him and continued to trail his footsteps until he sat in the open courtyard of the mosque. I said to him: 'O Commander of the Faithful, what is the sign of the Imamate — may God have mercy on you?' She said: He replied: 'Bring me that pebble,' and he gestured with his hand to a pebble. So I brought it to him, and he imprinted in it with his seal ring. Then he said to me: 'O Hababa! Whenever a claimant claims the Imamate and is able to imprint as you have seen, then know that he is an Imam whose obedience is obligatory; and the Imam — nothing that he wills escapes him.'

She said: Then I departed, until the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) passed away. I came to al-Hasan (peace be upon him) while he was in the gathering of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and the people were asking him. He said: 'O Hababa al-Walibiyya!' I said: 'Yes, my master.' He said: 'Give me what you have.' She said: So I gave it to him, and he imprinted in it just as the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) had imprinted.

She said: Then I came to al-Husayn (peace be upon him) while he was in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family). He drew me near and welcomed me, then said to me: 'Verily, within the sign there is a proof for what you desire — do you want the sign of the Imamate?' I said: 'Yes, my master.' He said: 'Give me what you have.' So I handed him the pebble, and he imprinted in it for me.

She said: Then I came to Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), but old age had overtaken me to the point that I trembled, and I was counting on that day one hundred and thirteen years. I saw him bowing, prostrating, and engrossed in worship. I despaired of receiving the sign. Then he gestured toward me with his index finger, and my youth returned to me. She said: So I asked: 'O my master, how much of the world has passed, and how much remains?' He said: 'As for what has passed — yes (I can tell you). But as for what remains — no.' She said: Then he said to me: 'Give me what you have.' So I gave him the pebble, and he imprinted in it for me.

Then I came to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and he imprinted in it for me. Then I came to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and he imprinted in it for me. Then I came to Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) and he imprinted in it for me. Then I came to al-Ridha (peace be upon him) and he imprinted in it for me.
And Hababa lived after that for nine months, according to what Muhammad ibn Hisham mentioned.

key_terms.إِمَامٌ مُفْتَرَضُ الطَّاعَةِ: An Imam whose obedience is obligatory (divinely mandated)
key_terms.دَلَالَةُ الْإِمَامَةِ: The sign/evidence of the Imamate; a miraculous proof identifying the legitimate Imam
key_terms.شُرْطَةُ الْخَمِيسِ: Elite guard or police force; the inner circle of guards associated with the Imam's administration
key_terms.طَبَعَ بِالْخَاتَمِ: Imprinting with the seal ring; the miraculous act that serves as the proof of Imamate
key_terms.مُسُوخ: Metamorphosed creatures; those divinely transformed as punishment — here referring to the forbidden fish as transformed Children of Israel

ai.seo_question: What is the story of Hababa al-Walibiyya and the miraculous sign of the Imamate in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This remarkable narrative narrates the testimony of Hababa al-Walibiyya, an exceptionally long-lived female companion who personally witnessed Imam Ali (AS) in action enforcing marketplace prohibitions — including forbidding the sale of certain fish — and received from him the miraculous sign (imprinting a seal on a pebble) that identifies a true Imam. Over the span of her extraordinary life of more than 113 years, she then presented this same pebble to Imams Hasan, Husayn, Ali ibn al-Husayn, Muhammad al-Baqir, Ja'far al-Sadiq, Musa al-Kazim, and Ali al-Ridha, each of whom reproduced the miracle, confirming their legitimate Imamate. The hadith serves as proof within the Shia tradition of the supernatural authority of the Imams and the continuity of divinely-appointed leadership through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Abu Ali Muhammad Bin Isnail Bin Musa Bin Ja’far, from Ahmad Bin Al Qasim Al Ijaly, from Ahmad Bin Yahya know as Kurdi, from Muhammad Bin Khudahy, from Abdullah Bin Ayoub, from Abdullah Bin Hashim, from Abdul Kareem Bin Amro Al Khash’amy, from Hababat Al Wailibiya who said,

‘I saw Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> among the elite police and with him was a whip of his<sup>asws</sup> having two branches to it. He<sup>asws</sup> was striking with it upon the sellers of the eels, and the moray and the angles (Prohibited fishes), and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying to them: ‘O sellers of the metamorphosed Children of Israel and the armies of the Clan of Marwan!’ So Furat Bin Akhnaf stood up to him<sup>asws</sup> and said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! What is the army of the Clan of Marwan?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘People who (used to) shave off the beards and twiddle the moustaches, so they were metamorphosed’.

So I had not seen a speaker speaking better than him<sup>asws</sup>. Then I followed him<sup>asws</sup> and did not cease missing his<sup>asws</sup> footsteps until he<sup>asws</sup> sat in an open space of the Masjid. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! What is the evidence of the Imamate? May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on you<sup>asws</sup>!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Bring to me<sup>asws</sup> that pebble’, and he<sup>asws</sup> gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> hand to a pebble. So I came over to him<sup>asws</sup> with it, and he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it with his<sup>asws</sup> ring for me, then said to me: ‘O Hababa! Whenever a claimant claims the Imamate and he<sup>asws</sup> is able to imprint just as you saw, so know that he<sup>asws</sup> is an Imam of Obligatory obedience, and the Imam<sup>asws</sup> is such that nothing escapes from him<sup>asws</sup> which he<sup>asws</sup> wants’.

She said, ‘Then I left, until such times as Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> passed away. So I went over to Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was in the seat of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> and the people were asking him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Hababa Al-Wailibiya!’ So I said, ‘Yes, my Master<sup>asws</sup>!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give me what is with you’. So I gave it (the imprinted) pebble, and he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it just as Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> had imprinted (beforehand).

She said, ‘Then I went over to Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> was in the Masjid of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> told me to come near and welcomed me, then said to me: ‘Regarding the evidence upon what you want, are you (still) wanting the evidence of the Imamate?’ So I said, ‘Yes, O my Chief!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give me what is with you’. So I gave the pebble to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it.

She said, ‘Then I went over to Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and there had reached with me the age that I was shaking, and I had counted that in those days I was one hundred and thirteen years old. So I saw him<sup>asws</sup> performing Ruk’u and Sajda, and was pre-occupied with the worship, so I despaired from the evidence. So he<sup>asws</sup> gestures towards me with the index finger, so my youth returned to me. So I said, ‘My Chief! How much from the world has passed and how much remains?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘As for what has passed, so yes, and as for what remains, so no’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Give me what is with you’. So I gave the pebble to him, and he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it for me.

Then I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it for me. Then I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it for me. Then I went over to Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> printed in it for me. Then I went over to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> imprinted in it for me’.
And Hababa lived after that for nine months upon what Muhammad Bin Hisham mentioned.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from abu Ali Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Musa ibn Ja’far from Ahmad ibn al-Qasim al-‘Ijli from Ahmad ibn Yahya, also known as Kurd from Muhammad ibn Khudahi from ‘Abdallah ibn Ayyub from ‘Abdallah ibn Hashim from ‘Abd al-Karim ibn ‘Amr al-Khath‘ami from Hababa al-Walibiyyah who has said the following.

“I saw Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) in the (market) place of the elite forces with a two pronged whip in his had. With it he would scare the sellers of inedible fish such as eel, moray and angler etc., and say, “O sellers of metamorphosed Israelites and the army of the descendants of Marwan, do not sale (inedible fishes).” At this time Frat ibn Ahnaf camme to him and said, “O Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.), ‘What is the army of the descendants of Marwan?” She has said that Ali (a.s.) said to him, “They groups of people who shaved their beards and crinkle their mustache and then they were metamorphosed.”

I had not heard any one speak better than him, I followed him without missing his traces until he sat down at an open space of the Mosque (of kufa). I then asked him, “O Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.), what are the signs of Imamat (Leadership with Divine Authority) may Allah grant you blessings? “ She has said that he said, “Bring to me that pebble.” He pointed with his hand. I then got the pebble for him and he set for me his seal on it. He then said to me, ‘O Hababa, if any one would claim to be the Imam (Leader with Divine Authority) and can set his seal as you just saw then acknowledge that he is the Imam that must be obeyed. The Imam does not miss what he would want.”

She has said, “I then left him until Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) was taken out of this world. Thereafter I went o al-Hassan (a.s.) who was sitting in the place of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and people around would ask him questions. He said to me, “O Hababa al-Walibyya.” I said, “Yes, my master.” He then said, “Give to me what is with you.” I then gave it to him. He set on it (his seal) just as Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) had done.

She has said, “Afterwards I went to al-Husayn (a.s.). He was in Mosque of the Messenger of Allah. He welcomed warmly and then said to me, “There is no doubt that in the proof ( to support the true Imam) there is already enough proof for what you want. Do you want the proof to know the Imam?” I said, “Yes, my master.” He then said, “Bring to me what have with you.” I gave him the pebble and he printed (his seal) on it.

She has said that afterwards I went o Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) but at that time I had become very old and my hands were shaky. I could count one hundred thirteen year of my lifetime. I found him in Ruku’ (kneeling in prayer) and Sujda (prostration) or busy in some form of worship. I became despaired about the proof (of Leadership with Divine Authority). He pointed out with his forefinger and my youth came back. She has said that she asked, “My mater, how much of the world is passed and how much is left?” He said, “ Of how much is passed yes (I can tell) but not of how much is to come.” She has that he then said to me, “give to me what is with you.” I then gave him the pebble and he printed on it (his seal) for me.

Thereafter I went ot abu Ja’far (a.s.) and he printed on it (his seal) for me. Then I went ot abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.). He printed on it (his seal) for me. Then I went to abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) and he printed (his seal) for me. Then I went to al-Rida and printed for me.”
According to abu Muhammad Hababa lived thereafter an other nine moths.”
